instruction: A cinematic video still, medium close-up, capturing two women dancing in an indoor studio against a plain backdrop. In the left foreground, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) laughs joyfully with her eyes closed, moving energetically. Behind her on the right, the Black woman in the red fringed dress (R1) smiles warmly while dancing with her hands raised. The blonde woman (R3) dominates the foreground while the Black woman (R1) dances slightly behind her, creating a lively, layered composition. Soft pink and purple studio lighting illuminates them with a warm, colorful glow.
